xlg13_screen_transfer_pearson_nfl_2020_2.classification_evidence: 4 candidates, bootstrap interval spans -1 to 1; no resolved sign, no split-half reliability measured and no positive control proven.
xlg13_screen_transfer_pearson_nfl_2020_2.description: Correlation across 4 candidates of pooled 14-input NFL opener accuracy gain (fixed opener-input harness) vs 88-input served gain (pearson); sign agreement 1 of 4.
xlg13_screen_transfer_pearson_nfl_2020_2.notes: Replaces the 2026-11-03 pre-fix values (spearman -0.40, pearson -0.84), which the lane struck: the pooled harness had used the closing spread as model input while grading at the opener. Screen gains now come from the fixed opener-input harness (artifacts/pooled_sweep_fixed, NFL opener 2020-25, n 1503, base 754-749): ridgecv +0.93, enet +0.60, accalpha -0.40, huber +0.73 accuracy points. Served gains (-0.73, -3.19, -1.80, -0.87) are unchanged from the MOD-23 units and were not re-verified after the fix. Family xlg13_screen_transfer, 2 looks. Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the artifact and lane; no new measurement.
xlg13_screen_transfer_pearson_nfl_2020_2.plain_summary: Whether a quick test on a small model predicts what the same change does to the full model: with only four examples the agreement leans positive and is not settled.
